'''Farren Dulz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed in [[Aurek Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] until [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] attacked and stole the signal jammers, turning them against the Republic. As there were not enough troops to reclaim all lost jammers, Dulz instead asked a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen to destroy them so that White Maw could not use them.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Farren Dulz appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Hoth, who starts the mission "Cutting Our Losses."
